hero.title: IT Infrastructure & Network Specialist · Team Lead · 24/7 Data Center
hero.subtitle: IT Infrastructure & Network Specialist · Team Lead · 24/7 Data Center
hero.bio: Network and infrastructure specialist with over 6 years of experience and strong field knowledge: large-scale data centers, structured cabling, fiber optics and on-site support at a mining site (Rio Tinto Project, Accenture). I have led support teams, coordinated operational handovers, managed vendors, contractors and SLAs, strengthened infrastructure security and kept critical services running, from the 21-branch network of a public agency to the 24/7 operation of an ISP with more than 50,000 subscribers. English C1.
